lcc_original: 那人和妻子都赤身裸體，也彼此不覺得羞恥。
notes: H01961 (הָיוּ, 'were') remains implicit {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} — LCC has no explicit copula verb, sentence is verbless in surface structure
H08147 (שְׁנֵיהֶם, 'both of them/the two') mapped to 都 — LCC uses 那人和妻子都 where 都 carries the distributive/both sense, though not the numeral
LCC's 覺得 ('feel/sense') is a Chinese complement verb added for naturalness with no direct Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated
LCC's 也彼此 ('also each other') is an interpretive expansion of the negation; 不 receives H03808 as the direct correspondent of לֹא
H0954 (בּוֹשׁ, 'ashamed') and WTH8709 both attach to 羞恥 as the lexical head; 覺得 is the semantically light complement
